label: bss-short-01

window.rule: header and K receipts both inside explicit capture window; straddlers excluded

configuration_groups.counts_scope: complete_frames is parsed framing only; trusted_complete_frames passes CRC, complete identity and the requested wire contract; point quality counts include only ordered trusted frames

rejected_frame_diagnostics.identity_mismatch_semantics: Value mismatches are observed text disagreements, not proof of a device configuration change; truncated numeric tokens can still be syntactically valid.

host_complete_frame_intervals.scope: adjacent ordered CRC/identity/wire-contract-valid complete protocol frames within this identity group; invalid points retained; duplicates/old frames excluded
host_complete_frame_intervals.clock: host receipt of the completing K line: USB RX chunk or BLE notification callback/reassembly, not device local completion or over-air arrival
host_complete_frame_intervals.time_coordinate: USB collector-relative event seconds; BLE absolute host monotonic seconds; never compare these coordinates directly
host_complete_frame_intervals.limits: No cross-identity/boot pairing; first/last receipt permit separate capture-edge coverage checks; equal timestamps can reflect one received chunk; no periodic-snapshot delivery guarantee is inferred

sequence.missing_semantics: missing CRC-and-identity-valid sequence observations; rejected complete frames can contribute, so do not add this count to CRC errors as independent losses
sequence.arithmetic: u32 modulo; distance 0 or >=2^31 is duplicate/old; never across identity groups

rates.capture_basis: ordered CRC-and-identity-valid frame sequence progression / device timestamp span
rates.host_basis: (trusted complete frames - 1) / first-to-last trusted K receipt time; bad CRC, incomplete/mismatched identity and wire-contract failures excluded

bytes.definition: wire=header+data/PGA/row lines+K including newlines; payload=data/PGA/row lines; diagnostics excluded

quality_count_scope: Only ordered frames passing CRC, complete identity and the requested wire contract enter point-quality totals; rejected frames remain separate. complete_frames is parsed framing, trusted_complete_frames is the trustworthy subset.
sequence_scope_note: Use group sequence statistics; the legacy parser whole-raw sequence counters are not boot/configuration aware.

ads_health.missing_boundary_records: NOT_ASSUMED_SUCCESSFUL; targets absent from maps are NOT_OBSERVED
ads_health.scope: diagnostic receipt window; queued logs may predate the first captured data identity; original seq/entry retained

telemetry_integrity.policy: STK50 memory requires the full emitted field layout through the named trunc suffix. PERF requires its full emitted layout; earlier heap/usbStackMin fields have following delimiters, but terminal heapMin has no following marker or CRC and remains unknown. No value-magnitude threshold is used; structural validation is not a checksum.
telemetry_integrity.numeric_minima_source: Only structurally complete capture-window STK50 records; unverified values remain diagnostic text.

memory.stack_scope: observed capture-window STK50 lifetime watermarks; PERF/USB query fields preserved separately

CTRL.counts_scope: whole independent raw stream; fault/reset phases and selected counter endpoints use the capture window

semantics: CDC0 control records are selected from the same raw stream; CDC1 debug never enters scientific CRC, identity, gap or FPS calculations.
Missing diagnostics are NOT_OBSERVED, not zero or proof of healthy operation.
Diagnostic layouts have no ASCII checksum; terminal numeric fields remain unverified.
USB accepted/callback bytes and BLE SDK acceptance do not acknowledge PC receipt.
SCHED observes idle progress and bounded work; it is not CPU utilization.

clock_alignment.basis: CTRL relative event time anchored to capture_start; CDC explicit host monotonic timestamps; no device timestamp substitution

diagnostic_source_policy: Formal CDC0 DATA/CTRL share one raw stream; use otg_diagnostics for control records and independent CDC1 debug. Missing telemetry is not zero.
